channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Yao Ming | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Yao Ming from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Andre Iguodala on LeBron James, Yao Ming
item.description:
Iguodala said of his former teammate.

“We'll still see his effect [on the game] 30, 40 years from now. People who never thought of playing in the NBA are trying to get there now because of him. There's only one LeBron James. A lot of people can have Steph's stature. So just like you when you have Yao Ming, you got 2 billion more people interested in basketball, you got a bunch of Stephs walking around.”

Andre Iguodala on LeBron James, Yao Ming, Jul 10, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Cuttino Mobley on Yao Ming, Brad Miller, Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Rick Adelman
item.description:
“It’s just the offense didn’t. Say we would’ve had Rick Adelman, for a fact, you would’ve seen more of Yao Ming. Like that Chris Webber, that Vlade Divac, Brad Miller type of passing. He had all of it.”

Cuttino Mobley on Yao Ming, Brad Miller, Chris Webber, Vlade Divac, Rick Adelman, Jul 3, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Derrick Favors on Yao Ming
item.description:
Favors, who stands 6-foot-9 and weighs about 265 pounds, recalled how Eaton was one of the few people he’d ever come across who could make him feel small.

“I mean, he was how tall — 7-3, 7-4? Yeah, 7-4. The only other player that I played against that was taller than that was Yao Ming, my rookie year,”

Derrick Favors on Yao Ming, May 30, 2021. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Gilbert Arenas on Yao Ming, Alonzo Mourning
item.description:
“The reason that I will average 40 is the fact there's no Shaq, Alonzo Mourning, Yao Ming back there. I don't know who's protecting this rim, but I'm pretty sure a 6-foot-5 power forward ain't stopping me from getting to the bucket,”

Gilbert Arenas on Yao Ming, Alonzo Mourning, Jan 6, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Yao Ming
item.description:
Raptors guard Kyle Lowry told ESPN.com.

“I've only played with one other guy like that, Yao Ming, where when he got it rolling, you can't stop him. Kawhi has been doing this for a month.”

Kyle Lowry on Yao Ming, May 6, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Yao Ming
item.description:
“The whole USA team had a bet. We had a million dollar bet on who was going to be the first person to dunk on Yao Ming. None of us did. We all tried to dunk on Yao, but he would block it or we would miss.”

Kevin Garnett on Yao Ming, Feb 18, 2019. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Yao Ming
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Dwyane Wade on Yao Ming:

“Oh man, groundbreaking. Our game is as big as it is globally because of Yao opening up so many doors for the NBA.”

Dwyane Wade on Yao Ming, Feb 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Yao Ming
item.description:
Dwain Price:#Mavs owner Mark Cuban:

“All those Dirk jerseys in Germany, we get 1/30th. All those Yao Ming jerseys in China, we get 1/30th:”

Mark Cuban on Yao Ming, Jul 13, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Carl Landry on Yao Ming
item.description:
Carl Landry:

“There's the possibility that I could sign a contract with the Shanghai Sharks. I would sign if Yao Ming pays me a lot of money [laughs].”

Carl Landry on Yao Ming, Jun 8, 2012. Source: NetEase.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Yao Ming
item.description:
Fran Blinebury:Rockets GM Daryl Morey:

“I think it’s too soon to know where we go from here exactly with Yao Ming.”

Daryl Morey on Yao Ming, Dec 17, 2010. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Yao Ming
item.description:
“With the uncertainty of the CBA and our team and in terms of where we go, just what we get from Yao Ming this year is a huge factor in terms of how we're planning our team,”

Daryl Morey on Yao Ming, Oct 1, 2010. Source: FanHouse.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Yao Ming
item.description:
Morey’s was clear, and he spoke of Yao’s return, he seemed to be rehearsing his recruiting pitch, citing everything from the Rockets’ roster to their popularity in China.

“I think (players) that are looking at the Rockets, they want the roster to look as good as possible and obviously Yao Ming is an unbelievable piece to have on a roster, a great center, an all-star and great teammate,”

Daryl Morey on Yao Ming, Jun 29, 2010. Source: Houston Chronicle.
